notes: מִבֵּית fuses to *between* under rule 30, headed on the construct noun, while the אֶל standing before it is left unrepresented under rule 40, the ASV writing one word for the whole compound.

*followeth her* promotes the object of אַחֲרֶיהָ to a direct object, so the preposition is unrepresented under rule 40 rather than fused with the participle; the suffix keeps the *her* written for it. The *over* of *that were set over the host* is the construct relation recast, which rule 19 names among its recastings, the passive *were set* reaching no object of its own.
